copy.headline: Battle Cats JP 15.5
copy.shortIntro: A JP-first update with Pac-Man collaboration content, new units, new forms, fresh talents, more stages, and a handful of progression rewards.

sections.title: Release Status
sections.summary: Japanese release: June 29, 2026. International release is still listed as TBA on the wiki, so this summary is assigned to JP only.

sections.title: New Cats
sections.summary: Five units were added, with CRO ids 866 through 870. The headline addition is the Pac-Man collaboration, plus a new Ancient Egg for Summer Break Cats Paradise.

sections.title: New Forms
sections.summary: Three True Forms and one Ultra Form were added. Mightycat gains speed plus Curse and Surge immunity, Ninja Girl Tomoe gets stronger control, Ancient Egg: N207 becomes a usable battle form, and Mighty Thermae D-Lux gets an Ultra Form with Relic targeting and Toxic immunity.

sections.title: Talents and Ultra Talents
sections.summary: Baby Mola and Hattori Hanzo received new Talent sets. Queen Reika received Ultra Talents, including Sage Slayer, Attack Frequency Up, and Slow.

sections.title: New Enemies
sections.summary: Pac-Man collaboration enemies and one new regular enemy were added.

sections.title: Stages
sections.summary: The update adds new Zero Legends maps, event stages, Pac-Man collaboration stages and gauntlets, Abyssal stages, Otherworld Colosseum content, plus 2-crown additions and several stage reward/energy/XP adjustments.

sections.title: Cat Combos
sections.summary: Two combos were added: one for Slow effect support and one Pac-Man combo for Resistant effect support.

sections.title: Other Changes
sections.summary: New User Rank rewards were added at 27,700, 27,800 and 27,900. Several units had their plus-level caps raised, and Gross Cat plus Ninja Cat now unlock after Cambodia instead of Philippines.
